notes.title: Demo v1.0.12 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Squad,



Today's update contains a change to how we handle lobbies to avoid a rare issue we've been seeing that can result in 5 players entering the same lobby - which breaks the game.


Bug Fixes
Fixed rare issue allowing more than 4 players to join the same lobby

notes.title: Demo v1.0.11 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Squad,



Small update today that fixes a handful of bugs caused by players joining lobbies from different machines but using the same steam account. Unfortunately, this is not supported as steam only allows players to be logged in from one device.


Bug Fixes
Fixed players not leaving the lobby when signing out from steam.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.10 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Squad,



Another round of bug fixes this week, as well as a change in the way we find open squads so that AFK people hosting a squad don't inadvertently block other players from finding an active squad.

Thank you again for all the bug reports and feedback!


Feature Changes
When finding open squads, try and avoid entering the same lobby repeatedly if multiple are available.


Bug Fixes
Fixed issue with music not playing when you start the game.

Fixed issue with animation events sometimes playing on dead enemies.

Fixed issue that can occur when waiting for players after picking an upgrade card.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.9 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Squad,



A few more bug fixes in this patch, as well as some additional reporting. We know a few of you have been having some disconnection issues occasionally, and this reporting will hopefully help us understand what's happening there. Thanks again for playing!


Bug Fixes
Fixed null reference related to settings screen.

Fixed a navigation edge case that could cause performance spikes.

Fixed player sometimes getting stuck on environmental objects.

Fixed issues during game shutdown when returning to lobby.

Improved reporting of errors.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.8 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Squad,



Just a handful of bug fixes in this patch.  Happy shooting!


Bug Fixes
Fixed rare issue that can occur when changing traits just as the game starts.

Fixed issue when trying to show an unbound control in-game.

Additional logs and checks to try and narrow down a rare, hard to reproduce issue.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.7 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Squad,



It's so great to see lots of you playing the demo, and that more and more people are discovering the game every day! Thank you all for playing and spreading the word!



This patch aims to fix various issues that have been popping up over the last couple of weeks - thank you for sending in your bug reports, they've been very helpful!



We've also taken the opportunity to add support for controls customization, which is something some of you have asked for. You can find this in the 'Controls' section of the 'Settings' menu.



Please continue to let us know if you encounter any issues - and once again, thank you all for playing!


[hr][/hr]

Feature Changes
Controls customization - The controls for keyboard/mouse and gamepad can now be customized in the Settings menu.

Improved behaviour when swapping between keyboard/mouse and controller.


Bug Fixes
Fixed very rare issue related to the amount of data being sent after a connection drops temporarily

Fixed jerkiness on remote clients during slow motion

Fixed issues when closing the game via Alt+F4 or Task Manager

Fixed rare issue on disconnect when leaving the lobby

Fixed issue causing remote clients to try to change values on accessibility sliders when they shouldn't

Fixed potential cause of stutter for a number of players

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hey squad,



First of all, a massive thank you to all the people that have played our demo so far. The response to the game has been incredible and we're very happy to see so many of you having a lot of fun with it! We've also been receiving a lot of great and constructive feedback, suggestions and ideas. Thanks to everyone that has taken the time to send it in - it's hugely appreciated.



After going over all the feedback, there were clearly some common themes and criticisms, primarily related to meta progression, traits system and the in-game upgrades. We agree with a lot of this feedback and, whilst we have plans for these areas, we want to take a little more time in order to make sure we address them properly. Unfortunately, that means we're not going to be able to release the game in July.



We don't expect to take too much longer - just a few extra weeks. Once we have an exact release date, you'll be the first to hear.



Thank you for your patience and continued support,



Martin & João

Bellyflop Games

notes.title: Demo v1.0.6 - Patch Notes

notes.title: Demo v1.0.3 - Accessibility Patch
notes.content:
Hi,



First things first, a big thank you once again to everybody who has been playing our demo and giving us feedback. It's been really helpful to hear what different players are enjoying and not enjoying. It's all valuable feedback, so thank you for taking the time to write it.



We're going to go through all the feedback after Next Fest is over to help figure out what needs to change and the direction to go in as we head towards the full release of the game.



However, one thing that has stood out in particular is that most people find the horde too hard to beat. We did want the game to be challenging so that it was something people could come back to, practice, and ultimately beat - but it seems we overshot the mark.



We've decided to address that with a couple things:

We have tweaked the medpack drops so that you get slightly more on average and, crucially, ensure a minimum amount each game.

We have added accessibility sliders in the lobby, which the host can set, for:

Horde Size (50% to 150%) - decrease or increase the amount of enemies spawning.

Horde Health (50% to 150%) - decrease or increase the amount of health enemies have.

We encourage players to try the game without modifiers but now you can make the game easier (or harder!) to your liking. Hopefully you can find a level of challenge that suits you. If you do, we'd love to know what values were right for you as it'll help us tweak the balance for the full game. You can leave a comment on this post or reach out to us in any of the other feedback channels - steam discussions, discord, google forms, etc.



Thanks again for playing, and good luck!


[hr][/hr]

Feature Changes
Adjusted medpack drop frequencies and ensured minimum number of medpacks per game

Added 'Horde Size' and 'Horde Health' accessibility sliders in the lobby

New graphical cursors for UI and gameplay

Improved UI animations in card selection screen

Added music to frontend

Added visual notification when new content has been unlocked


Bug Fixes
Fixed medpacks spawning at the center of the map for remote players

Fixed some UI issues when collecting multiple crates at the same time

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Our Next Fest demo is here!
This is a new and improved demo with more of almost everything - More maps to survive, more weapons to master, more difficulties to conquer, and an entirely new mechanic to play with! It's also had a whole array of polish, juice and love applied across the board.  So if you played the Beta Test demo, it will be worth jumping in again to try and beat the horde once more!



While this demo is still just a small sample of the full game, it features:

2 difficulties

3 maps

8 weapons

12 character traits


Character Traits
We're introducing traits which affect your character in a variety of ways, usually under specific conditions, requiring you to adapt and change how you play. They represent both strengths and flaws, and you must take the good with the bad.

In this demo, you will have 4 unlockable trait slots and a sample of 12 traits to choose from, already unlocked for convenience. In the full game, the traits must also be unlocked by meeting specific requirements. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545014/d6743e809f3c93fdebf0a96f2d47070ba478de85.png"]


Patch notes

Feature Changes
Gameplay

Added Character Traits

Adjusted navigation priorities to improve how faster enemies traverse through dense groups of enemies

Adjusted colliders on dismembered limbs to prevent them rolling for too long

Added a revive progress indicator

Tweaked some enemy AI and refactored their melee attack system

Added 2 map layouts

Improved hit detection on remote clients

Graphical improvements

Added emissive glows on explosions, bullets, weapons and more

New VFX for player down

Improved supply crate VFX

Improved medpack VFX and added animations for spawn and pickup

Improved VFX on enemy hits

Improved VFX on some enemy attacks

Added new animations to some enemies

Tweaked bullet graphics

Improved damage numbers graphics

Added VFX for player healing

Audio

Added music during gameplay

New sound effects across the board, with better balancing and spatial effects.


Bug Fixes
Fixed some wall colliders causing players to get stuck on some corners

Fixed some edge cases in pathfinding causing paths to go through blocked areas

Fixed enemies sometimes not throwing grenades

Fixed some UI elements in 16:10 resolutions

Fixed some UI issues when opening multiple crates at once





We hope you have fun playing and thank you for trying our demo!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
As some of you have noticed, we have been actively updating the demo over the last few days. These updates have been mainly focused on bug fixing and QoL updates. Here's a full breakdown of what we've been up to:

Feature Changes

Added in-game controls display to help new players
Downed players in squad games will now automatically spectate other players
Player character now ragdolls on death when playing in Lone Wolf or when they're the last player alive in a squad
Escape/back buttons on keyboard/controller now cancel readiness in lobby or go to previous screen
Launching the game from a friend invite now joins directly into lobby


Bug Fixes

Fixed crash caused by a memory allocation issue
Fixed possible memory leak when returning to main menu after playing a game
Fixed players getting stuck on card selection screen after other players disconnect
Fixed errors in the card selection system caused by returning to main menu during card selection
Fixed some issues with input behaviour when swapping between controller and mouse/keyboard
Fixed players sometimes not regaining control of their character after exiting the card selection screen
Fixed players sometimes getting stuck on the escape menu
Fixed error when trying to update stats for a player that had disconnected
Fixed ragdoll joints causing glitching/stretching/spinning ragdolls
Fixed issue caused by the host disconnecting during startup
Fixed players sometimes getting stuck running without control after being revived
Fixed issue with timeout mechanism when trying to connect to the host
Fixed a controller issue when leaving the card selection screen requiring players to release the trigger before being able to fire again
Fixed some UI elements being cut off in 16:10 resolutions



Thank you all for trying our demo and sending us your bugs and feedback!
